anatomy.interpretation: One head/face, one dorsal fin, paired right/left fins, one tail fin. Body/back/weapon/floating slots are mechanical, not extra limbs. No hands/feet/legs. Intrinsic catfish mouth/barbels/gills are ordinary fish anatomy; exact barbel count/proportions and unseen surfaces are authored, not slot-derived.

baseline.policy: Reusable unmutated normal catfish morphology first. Gills12/DarkVision2 are native aquatic/sensory behaviors, not reasons to graft extra limbs/tails. Preserve metadata and normal intrinsic fish gills; no individual mutation-granted appendages or outfit baked in.
baseline.age: No explicit native age/life-stage established; do not invent child residents or change demographics.

natural_equipment.interpretation: Glowfish_Bite is default Face behavior, not an external handheld item, extra head or clothing fit. Observed equipped list is empty.

palette.policy: Pure equal-RGB neutral art and separate primary/detail ownership, one coverage plane. No magenta/cyan baked into neutral, fixed-color fallback, water tint, glow halo or emissive artwork. Native light radius1 remains native.

catfish_feature.role: Catfish flattened head/barbel/anatomical cue only. This is resource art, not a live directional pawn; do not import dead-food pose, colour, stack pictures or eating mechanics.

camera: Use actual live fish-pawn cardinal map convention: S head towards bottom, E head right, N head top. Entire normal fish turns, no human upright stance or independently turned head. Preserve source curl in a coherent swimming-plane form; unseen body depth/fin placement remain authored. Front design is constructed first, then actual ImageGen E/N from that front and these facts.
rendering_contract: Whole animal body graphics with two tint channels. Mechanical Head/Fin slots do not require independent render bones/limb models. Retain normal head/fins in whole body; no invented articulated fins, clothing framework, per-facing bbox scaling or source-unknown animation.

frame.policy: Common centered trunk/swim pivot and scale for all facings; asymmetrical source curl may extend off axis. Do not recenter each alpha bbox or normalize body length by facing.
frame.world_size_provenance: Authored template scale, not a native measured body dimension; final native acceptance after all generation.
